summary: Iter 24 — Final E2E verification before production. Backend: 22/23 pytest passed (test_iter24_final_verification.py) + all 11 iter23 tests still pass (33/34 total). Verified Scenarios A–L, N–V. Found ONE new CRITICAL backend bug in Scenario M: GET /api/leads/{id} returns HTTP 500 for any lead whose assigned_to field is a UUID (which is the case for GP-assigned leads). Frontend loads correctly — Data page shows 457 total data with all status filters (All/New/Not Interested/Follow Up/Lead/File/No Status) and call outcome filters (Connected/No Answer/Switched Off/Not Connecting/Busy/Wrong Number/Voicemail/Never Called) rendered. Admin Dashboard shows 'All Growth Partners' and 'Active Growth Partners' terminology. Login endpoint returns token; auth works.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when the lead's assigned_to field contains a UUID (e.g., 'd4dad061-7403-4e38-bb06-b3cdf277237b'). Root cause: /app/backend/routes/leads.py line 471 calls `ObjectId(lead_data['assigned_to'])` unconditionally, which raises bson.errors.InvalidId for non-24-hex values. Since users are stored with UUID ids in this codebase, ANY File Detail view for an assigned lead will crash. Fix: mirror the defensive pattern from list_leads (lines 275-288): check length==24 before ObjectId(), then fallback to `db.users.find_one({'id': assigned_id})` or `{'connect_id': assigned_id}`, wrapped in try/except.

rca of the issue: Bug: GET /api/leads/{lead_id} → HTTP 500. Reproduction: 1) POST /api/auth/login {admin@bankezee.com/ConnectSasha12!!} → get token. 2) GET /api/leads?status=file&limit=1 → note the first lead's id. 3) GET /api/leads/{id} → 500. Root cause: /app/backend/routes/leads.py line 471 executes `ObjectId(lead_data['assigned_to'])` where assigned_to is a UUID string like 'd4dad061-7403-4e38-bb06-b3cdf277237b'. bson.ObjectId() requires a 12-byte or 24-hex string and raises bson.errors.InvalidId otherwise. Mitigation: replace the block at lines 470-475 with the same defensive lookup used at lines 275-288 (`if len(assigned_id) == 24: try ObjectId; then fallback to {'connect_id': assigned_id} or {'id': assigned_id}`), wrapped in try/except to fail gracefully (return the lead without telecaller_name enrichment). Estimated fix: <10 lines. Impact of NOT fixing: File Detail page in the CRM UI is broken for every file that has a Growth Partner assigned (which is the majority).
